name: snowflake
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A SINGLE tiny six-armed snowflake particle for a polished 3D cartoon winter forest mobile game. Simple symmetrical six-armed ice crystal, soft rounded beveled branches, solid icy white center and pale sky-blue edge shading so it reads against both pale and dark backgrounds, lightly dimensional rather than line art. One compact clear snowflake fitting final 48x48 transparent RGBA with small clear margins. No circular badge, no glow halo, no drop shadow, no dots around it, no background, text, border or extra crystals. Genuine transparent background.
